name: ResumeBuilderPanel
description: Panel body content for the resume builder editor. 25 variants covering all resume section editors: Home (default view), Personal Information, Working Experience (collapse/expand), Formal Education (collapse/expand), Skills, Courses, Achievements, Additional Information, and a Design Tab for template/style customization. Two-column layout: left navigation + right editor.

section-left.note: Sidebar navigation — section list for the resume

section-right.note: Editor area — form fields for the active section

usage.generic: ResumeBuilderPanel(type='HomeDefault', resumeId='r-001') — place inside Panel(SingleCard) body

do: Show section navigation on the left.
Save changes automatically or on explicit action.
dont: Don't lose unsaved changes when switching sections without warning.
